note: The fourth para and teacher tool, published 2026-09-29, a day after the other three. Same rules as working-together-para.json: TDI voice only, explain why the tool is built the way it is, ask the reader something, never testify.

posts: The two columns are not there for symmetry. They exist so the para can fill in her half and hand the page over, which turns a conversation that needed scheduling into one that needs a spare minute.
Keep both copies. The value of a written agreement shows up in February, when something feels unclear and neither person can remember what was actually agreed in August.
If you filled in your column today and left it on a desk, what is the first thing you would write in it?
For the teachers here, would you rather be handed this half finished, or asked for a meeting about it first?
